title: 3MG active Parquet schema catalogue
scope: Active Parquet outputs and cache families referenced by the current 3MARS WP2 base-network pipeline, plus the retained feed-level MobilityDatabase provenance table. Row counts describe the audited local snapshot and are not schema constraints.

conventions.id_scope: Integer identifiers are table-local unless a foreign key or globally prefixed node identifier is stated.
conventions.day_id: Integer encoding equal to YYYYMMDD minus 20200101; it is not elapsed days.
conventions.gtfs_time: Condensed GTFS values are seconds from the service-day origin.
conventions.intercity_time: Intercity timetable and final graph times are minutes; public transport uses a fixed winter UTC offset.
conventions.ordered_lists: List columns preserve order unless described as provenance or membership collections.
conventions.nullability_note: Parquet fields are physically nullable; descriptions and primary-key metadata state intended semantics.
